completion_effect_preferences_catalog_ch.name: completion_effect_preferences_catalog_check
completion_effect_preferences_catalog_ch.value: ("completion_effect_preferences"."theme" = 'Calm' AND "completion_effect_preferences"."palette" IN ('Haze', 'Pebble', 'Linen', 'Moss')) OR ("completion_effect_preferences"."theme" = 'Weave' AND "completion_effect_preferences"."palette" IN ('Loom', 'Cord', 'Lattice', 'Knot')) OR ("completion_effect_preferences"."theme" = 'Arc' AND "completion_effect_preferences"."palette" IN ('Gleam', 'Trace', 'Halo', 'Span')) OR ("completion_effect_preferences"."theme" = 'Nova' AND "completion_effect_preferences"."palette" IN ('Ember', 'Pulse', 'Orbit', 'Flare'))

document_folder_check.name: document_folder_check
document_folder_check.value: "document"."folder" is null or length(btrim("document"."folder")) between 1 and 255

document_ownership_check.name: document_ownership_check
document_ownership_check.value: ("document"."project_id" IS NOT NULL AND "document"."workspace_id" IS NULL) OR ("document"."project_id" IS NULL AND "document"."workspace_id" IS NOT NULL)

document_conflict_draft_ownership_check.name: document_conflict_draft_ownership_check
document_conflict_draft_ownership_check.value: ("document_conflict_draft"."project_id" IS NOT NULL AND "document_conflict_draft"."workspace_id" IS NULL) OR ("document_conflict_draft"."project_id" IS NULL AND "document_conflict_draft"."workspace_id" IS NOT NULL)

smart_collection_subscription_membership.name: smart_collection_subscription_membership_state_check
smart_collection_subscription_membership.value: ("smart_collection_subscription_membership"."is_member" = true and "smart_collection_subscription_membership"."left_at" is null) or ("smart_collection_subscription_membership"."is_member" = false and "smart_collection_subscription_membership"."left_at" is not null)

technical_diagram_authority_mode_check.name: technical_diagram_authority_mode_check
technical_diagram_authority_mode_check.value: "technical_diagram"."authority_mode" in ('Product-authored Model', 'Imported Independent Copy', 'External Source Link')

file_attachment_scope_check.name: file_attachment_scope_check
file_attachment_scope_check.value: ("file_attachment"."scope_type" = 'Project' and "file_attachment"."project_id" is not null and "file_attachment"."personal_wiki_id" is null) or ("file_attachment"."scope_type" = 'Personal Wiki' and "file_attachment"."project_id" is null and "file_attachment"."personal_wiki_id" is not null)

file_attachment_upload_scope_check.name: file_attachment_upload_scope_check
file_attachment_upload_scope_check.value: ("file_attachment_upload"."scope_type" is null and "file_attachment_upload"."project_id" is null and "file_attachment_upload"."personal_wiki_id" is null) or ("file_attachment_upload"."scope_type" = 'Project' and "file_attachment_upload"."project_id" is not null and "file_attachment_upload"."personal_wiki_id" is null) or ("file_attachment_upload"."scope_type" = 'Personal Wiki' and "file_attachment_upload"."project_id" is null and "file_attachment_upload"."personal_wiki_id" is not null)

project_starter_configuration_check.name: project_starter_configuration_check
project_starter_configuration_check.value: "project"."starter_configuration" in ('Blank Project', 'Solo SaaS', 'Open Source Library', 'Mobile Application')

priority_metric_definition_rank_descript.name: priority_metric_definition_rank_descriptions_check
priority_metric_definition_rank_descript.value:
jsonb_typeof("priority_metric_definition"."rank_descriptions") = 'object'
        and "priority_metric_definition"."rank_descriptions" ?& array['Very low', 'Low', 'Medium', 'High', 'Very high']
        and "priority_metric_definition"."rank_descriptions" - array['Very low', 'Low', 'Medium', 'High', 'Very high'] = '{}'::jsonb

work_priority_metric_value_rank_check.name: work_priority_metric_value_rank_check
work_priority_metric_value_rank_check.value: "work_priority_metric_value"."rank" is null or "work_priority_metric_value"."rank" in ('Very low', 'Low', 'Medium', 'High', 'Very high')

personal_reminder_condition_check.name: personal_reminder_condition_check
personal_reminder_condition_check.value: "personal_reminder"."condition" in ('In any case', 'Only if still open')

personal_reminder_status_check.name: personal_reminder_status_check
personal_reminder_status_check.value:
(
        ("personal_reminder"."status" = 'Planned' and "personal_reminder"."cancelled_at" is null and "personal_reminder"."triggered_at" is null)
        or ("personal_reminder"."status" = 'Triggered' and "personal_reminder"."cancelled_at" is null and "personal_reminder"."triggered_at" is not null)
        or ("personal_reminder"."status" = 'Cancelled' and "personal_reminder"."cancelled_at" is not null and "personal_reminder"."triggered_at" is null)
      )

capture_inbox_item_template_check.name: capture_inbox_item_template_check
capture_inbox_item_template_check.value: "capture_inbox_item"."template" is null or "capture_inbox_item"."template" in ('Bug Capture', 'Feedback Capture', 'Research Fragment')

work_effort_check.name: work_effort_check
work_effort_check.value: "work"."effort" is null or length(btrim("work"."effort")) between 1 and 255

work_closed_result_check.name: work_closed_result_check
work_closed_result_check.value: ("work"."status" = 'Closed' and "work"."closure_result" is not null) or ("work"."status" <> 'Closed' and "work"."closure_result" is null and "work"."closure_reason" is null)

work_external_handoff_cancellation_reaso.name: work_external_handoff_cancellation_reason_check
work_external_handoff_cancellation_reaso.value: ("work_external_execution_handoff"."status" = 'Canceled' and "work_external_execution_handoff"."cancellation_reason" is not null and length(btrim("work_external_execution_handoff"."cancellation_reason")) > 0) or ("work_external_execution_handoff"."status" <> 'Canceled' and "work_external_execution_handoff"."cancellation_reason" is null)

work_draft_finalization_check.name: work_draft_finalization_check
work_draft_finalization_check.value: "work_draft"."consumed_at" is null or "work_draft"."finalized_work_id" is not null

work_not_now_trail_close_state_check.name: work_not_now_trail_close_state_check
work_not_now_trail_close_state_check.value:
(
        "work_not_now_trail"."status" = 'Active'
        and "work_not_now_trail"."closed_at" is null
        and "work_not_now_trail"."closed_by" is null
        and "work_not_now_trail"."closed_by_account_id" is null
        and "work_not_now_trail"."closed_by_client_idempotency_key" is null
        and "work_not_now_trail"."closed_by_payload_fingerprint" is null
      ) or (
        "work_not_now_trail"."status" in ('Reconsidered', 'Replaced')
        and "work_not_now_trail"."closed_at" is not null
        and "work_not_now_trail"."closed_by_account_id" is not null
        and "work_not_now_trail"."closed_by_client_idempotency_key" is not null
        and "work_not_now_trail"."closed_by_payload_fingerprint" is not null
        and (
          ("work_not_now_trail"."status" = 'Reconsidered' and "work_not_now_trail"."closed_by" = 'Reconsidering')
          or ("work_not_now_trail"."status" = 'Replaced' and "work_not_now_trail"."closed_by" = 'Replaced')
        )
      )

usage_link_kind_check.name: usage_link_kind_check
usage_link_kind_check.value: "usage_link"."kind" in ('Inline reference', 'Section reference', 'Live block', 'Pinned bind', 'Screen reference')

work_relation_unique_per_source_uidx.name: work_relation_unique_per_source_uidx
work_relation_unique_per_source_uidx.where: "work_relation"."deleted_at" is null and "work_relation"."kind" in ('Primary spec', 'Belongs to Company', 'Participant')

work_relation_kind_check.name: work_relation_kind_check
work_relation_kind_check.value: "work_relation"."kind" in ('Related', 'Origin', 'Evidence', 'Contributes to Goal', 'Blocks', 'Includes', 'Contributes to Milestone', 'Primary spec', 'Supersedes', 'Implements', 'Belongs to Company', 'Participant', 'Required for completion')

work_relation_broken_reason_check.name: work_relation_broken_reason_check
work_relation_broken_reason_check.value: "work_relation"."broken_reason" is null or "work_relation"."broken_reason" in ('Archived', 'In Trash', 'Permanently deleted', 'Redacted for security', 'No access')

work_relation_blocking_status_check.name: work_relation_blocking_status_check
work_relation_blocking_status_check.value: ("work_relation"."kind" <> 'Blocks' and "work_relation"."blocking_status" is null and "work_relation"."blocking_resolved_at" is null and "work_relation"."blocking_resolution_note" is null) or ("work_relation"."kind" = 'Blocks' and "work_relation"."blocking_status" = 'Active' and "work_relation"."blocking_resolved_at" is null and "work_relation"."blocking_resolution_note" is null) or ("work_relation"."kind" = 'Blocks' and "work_relation"."blocking_status" = 'Resolved')
